notes.title: Version 1.80 with Steam Deck support
notes.content:
This version comes on a custom build of Redot 4.4, with improved performance and stability.
We have added full support for controllers, and with that, we have tested the build on Steam Deck.

Most important features:

[list]
[*] Added Portuguese language support.
[*] Added full support for controllers.
[*] Verified on Steam Deck.
[*] Improved performance.
[*] Improved stability.
[/list]

Known issue: on MacOS, the engine has some minor stutter when the game is run in window. Going full screen fixes the problem.

notes.title: Island Update (Version 1.50)
notes.content:
[h1]Fly Happier than ever[/h1][p]In this release we focused on three aspects: usability, onboarding experience and performance. [/p][p]The user is now guided through a series of hints and interactive tutorials to get into the mechanics of the game right from the start.[/p][p]As the text plays now an important role in helping the players enjoying the game, we added translations for French, German, Italian, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese.[/p][p]The first 4 level (Island) have been visually redesigned, and rebalanced to offer a smoother difficulty curve, so that level 4 and 4S are less difficult than level 5.[/p][p]Performance has been greatly improved, nailing frame rate to 60 also on less performing computers (and computer busy with VStreaming).Some stability issues in endless levels have been solved.[/p][p][i]This is the last release before we introduce additional content: more levels and skins for the relax mode.[/i][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p] Greatly improved onboarding experience, now level 1 is a training ground an interactive tutorial.
[/p][/*][*][p] Revamped island levels with better graphics and more gradual difficulty ramp.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added language support: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese and Chinese (simplified).
[/p][/*][*][p] Greatly improved startup time on mobile, with compressed resources.
[/p][/*][*][p] Greatly improved performance.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved frame rate on low-end devices.
[/p][/*][*][p] Hinting at dual controls options.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed stability issues.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 1.27
notes.content: This build main change is an optimisation and stabilisation of procedural level generation. While we didn't observe any crash on desktop platforms, we have ported some changes that have improved performance on mobile platforms.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.20
notes.content:
* Give suggestion to see the tutorial if not seen before, when accessing the first level.
* Added the option to use separate controls for glide and bash.
